Hi Daniel — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful.

Short answers up front:
- DPA / SCCs: Yes, Redwood executes a DPA and supports the EU Commission SCCs (the 2021 standard clauses). We can provide the template and markups for legal review.
- HIPAA / BAA: We offer multiple paths. Hosted (shared) cannot be covered by a Redwood BAA today. We can support HIPAA via Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) or an enterprise Dedicated deployment with a signed BAA plus controls. I'll loop Neha (privacy lead) and Ben (sales lead) to map the recommended option for HealthSync's flows.
- SOC 2 Type II: We can share a redacted report; attaching the latest redacted artifact and a simplified dataflow image for initial review.

I've attached a partially completed SIG (tabbed with our responses) and a PNG dataflow snapshot. Neha will take point on the detailed SIG responses and can propose language for DPA/SCCs.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-min call this week (Neha + Ben + your legal) to confirm HIPAA path and deployment preference.
2) We finish the SIG questions (Neha) and deliver a final package + redacted SOC2 by 11/19.

If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,

Aisha / Ben — following up after Daniel's note. Key points for our SIG completion:

- DPA/SCCs: We should offer the 2021 SCCs (controller-to-processor) and include standard transfer mechanisms where customer's org is controller. Legal will want to redline our DPA but that's expected.
- HIPAA: Confirmed — hosted multi-tenant product cannot be covered by our standard BAA. Options:
  * Redwood Private (VPC) with customer-managed keys and network isolation — acceptable for a BAA.
  * Dedicated with contractual safeguards and limited multi-tenancy (requires infra commitment).
- Dataflow: Need their expected PHI fields and retention window to assess whether additional controls are required (tokenization, pseudonymization).

I will:
- Complete the SIG security/technical sections with specifics on encryption, key management, and logging.
- Draft recommended DPA markup focusing on SCC adoption and export controls.

Ben — can you confirm the proposed commercial path (Dedicated vs Private) and whether they're evaluating on-prem? Also flag whether HealthSync needs managed SOC evidence only or continuous attestation (they asked for vendor approval fast).

Neha

Hi Ben / team — quick answers from HealthSync legal:

- We can accept a BAA if you can provide contractual language and evidence of SOC 2 and network isolation for the Private deployment. We do not require on-prem as long as persistent PHI processing is in an isolated VPC with customer-managed keys.
- Confirm the SCCs version: we prefer the 2021 SCCs; please provide your DPA with the corresponding references.
- Evidence: redacted SOC 2 Type II and a network/dataflow diagram are required for our comms team.

We saw the partial SIG and the flow diagram — helpful. For PHI details, we'll send a short appendix listing expected fields and retention, but plan on standard HIPAA retention unless otherwise agreed.

Next step: please send the completed SIG and redacted SOC 2 by EOD 11/19 so our procurement can move to approvals on 11/24. Also share the proposed BAA template or a summary of controls you can commit to.

Regards,
HealthSync Legal Ops
